prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my left ran the red and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and pushed it onto the curb. I held the steering wheel and braced myself, but my left wrist hit the door frame and I felt an immediate, sharp pain. Paramedics arrived within minutes and I was taken to the emergency room, where an X-ray confirmed a fractured wrist. I have told this same account every time I have described the collision, to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement for review.
